subject: SOC 2 artifact owners + SSO & encryption deep-dive — availability
messages:
From: Amira Shah <amira.shah@medibridge.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Turner <kyle.turner@medibridge.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 deep-dive (SSO/encryption/audit logs) — request for architecture review

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the onboarding so far. Our security and compliance teams would like a focused architecture review that covers:
- SOC 2 artifact ownership and expected evidence (who in your org will own each artifact)
- Encryption at rest and in transit (key management details, rotation cadence)
- Audit log retention, format, and sampling approach
- SSO/SAML configuration and IdP support (just-in-time provisioning, SCIM, assertion attributes)

We'd like a technical deep-dive with the people who own those areas on your side so we can map evidence to our controls. Do you have 60–90 minute slots this week or early next week? Our preference is PST morning.

Also: please attach any current evidence map or diagram you can share ahead of the call.

Best,
Amira Shah
CISO, MediBridge

[attachment: none in original]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Amira Shah <amira.shah@medibridge.com>
Cc: Kyle Turner <kyle.turner@medibridge.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 deep-dive (SSO/encryption/audit logs) — request for architecture review

Hi Amira — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to run the session. Proposed approach: 60–75 minutes, split as follows:
- 10 min: intro + scope and targets
- 35 min: technical walkthrough (encryption key flow, SSO auth flow, audit log pipeline)
- 20 min: mapping artifacts to SOC 2 controls + Q&A

Availability (PST mornings):
- Thu 14 Jan, 09:00–10:30
- Fri 15 Jan, 10:00–11:30 (I know this is slightly later)
- Mon 18 Jan, 08:30–10:00

Attendees from Redwood: Neha (security operations / audit logs), Karthik (platform security / SSO), Mina (crypto & key management). Can you confirm the MediBridge attendees (beyond you/Kyle) and who will be the evidence owner for each control on your side?

I'll attach our latest evidence map and the high-level SAML flow diagram for prep. If the team wants a longer session, we can split follow-ups by area.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer — Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_map_v1.xlsx, sso-saml-flow-diagram.png

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Amira Shah <amira.shah@medibridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Kyle Turner <kyle.turner@medibridge.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 deep-dive (SSO/encryption/audit logs) — request for architecture review

Adding a quick note from my side on artifacts and what I'll present:
- Audit logs: what we emit (auth events, admin actions, data access), storage (WORM-capable bucket), retention/encryption-at-rest details, and an example of our rotated log archive.
- Evidence I can surface during the call: logging config snippets, retention policy doc excerpt, ingestion pipeline diagram.

Mina will cover key management (KMS/HSM boundaries, rotation, envelope encryption) — Mina, I attached the latest policy draft (encryption_key_policy_v2.pdf) for context.

If Thu 14 Jan 09:00 PST works for MediBridge, I can be on that slot. Otherwise Mon 18 Jan 08:30 PST also works for me.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: encryption_key_policy_v2.pdf

From: Amira Shah <amira.shah@medibridge.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Turner <kyle.turner@medibridge.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 deep-dive (SSO/encryption/audit logs) — request for architecture review

Thanks — Thu 14 Jan 09:00 PST works for us. Please send a calendar invite with a Teams link and include the attachments in the invite or in the meeting notes.

One ask ahead of time: could you flag which SOC 2 controls you consider "in scope" vs "out of scope" for Redwood-managed components? Having that mapping will speed the evidence review on our side.

We'll have: Amira (CISO), Kyle (IT Ops), Jenna Lopez (Compliance Manager) attending.

Appreciate it — see you Thursday.

Best,
Amira
CISO, MediBridge

[Calendar invite to follow by Priya]
